comments.headline: Transformer equipment and service specifications missing
comments.summary: Electrical specifications do not identify transformer type (oil-filled vs. dry-type), service configuration (standard vs. niche), service type (single vs. three-phase), or gas utility service presence. Multiple clearance, design, and documentation requirements are contingent on these specifications and cannot be verified.
comments.crossDep: Architectural (fire rating for niche service); Utility company (gas service confirmation)
comments.attn: Equipment/service specifications must be confirmed from electrical designer and cross-checked against AE Design requirements document.

details.text: Transformer type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified on electrical plan. Window, door, and ventilating duct clearance requirements (12 feet if oil-filled and <5-foot lateral separation; 10 feet otherwise) vary by type and cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: No window, door, or ventilating duct locations are dimensioned relative to transformer pads. The requirement applies to oil-filled equipment when windows/doors/ducts are less than 12 feet from grade or lack 5-foot lateral separation; however, transformer type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on the plans.

Electrical specifications do not identify any transformers as oil-filled equipment. Building elevations showing windows, doors, and ventilating ducts with grade elevations and lateral clearance dimensions are not provided. Without transformer type confirmation and detailed elevation information, 12-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified.
Transformer equipment specifications (oil-filled vs. dry-type) and building elevations showing window/door locations not provided. 12-foot clearance requirement from windows/doors cannot be verified.

details.text: Transformer type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified. Liquid drainage direction requirement (away from buildings) applies only to oil-filled equipment and cannot be verified without equipment type confirmation.

runComments.comment: The requirement applies specifically to oil-filled equipment—liquid flow must be directed away from buildings. Transformer type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on the electrical plan. General grading analysis on Sheet 11 suggests drainage slopes direct flow away from buildings in the areas where transformers are located, but specific confirmation of transformer type and pad-level grading is not documented.

Electrical specifications do not identify whether any transformers are oil-filled equipment. Grading and Drainage Plan (Sheet 11) does not show surface flow direction or grading slopes specifically around transformer pad locations. Without confirmation of oil-filled equipment type and documentation of drainage direction away from buildings, compliance with liquid-flow-away-from-building requirement cannot be verified.
Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified on electrical plan. Drainage direction requirement for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified.

details.text: Fire escapes and stairwells are not identified or shown on electrical plan or fire protection plan adjacent to transformer pad locations. Fire escape clearance requirement (20 feet for oil-filled equipment only) cannot be verified without fire escape documentation and equipment type confirmation.

runComments.comment: Stairwells and fire escapes are not shown on the electrical or fire protection plans in proximity to transformer pads. Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows fire lanes and hydrants but does not identify stairwells or fire escapes adjacent to transformer locations. Compliance cannot be verified from available documentation.

details.text: Fire escape clearance (minimum 20 feet) is required only if transformers are oil-filled equipment. Equipment type not documented on electrical specifications, so fire escape clearance requirement applicability and compliance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Electrical specifications do not confirm whether any transformers are oil-filled. Building elevations or sections showing fire escape locations in relation to transformer pads are not provided. The 20-foot fire escape clearance requirement applies only to oil-filled equipment and cannot be verified without equipment type confirmation and fire escape location documentation.

Fire hydrant location shown on Fire Protection Plan but clearance dimension from transformer pad not provided. 20-foot requirement for oil-filled equipment cannot be verified without equipment specifications and dimensions.

details.text: Gas utility service presence not documented on site/utility plans. If gas service is proposed, horizontal clearance of 24 inches (<60 psi) or 36 inches (≥60 psi) from gas lines is required but cannot be verified without confirming gas service presence.

runComments.comment: Site plans do not show gas utility infrastructure or identify whether gas service is proposed to the site. Utility Plan (Sheet 19) legend does not include gas line symbols or routing. Compliance with 24-inch (pressures <60 psi) or 36-inch (pressures ≥60 psi) clearance from gas lines cannot be evaluated without confirmation of gas service presence and pipeline locations.

details.text: If Transformer Pad 3 within the Vault Easement represents a niche service installation, 35-foot minimum vertical clearance requirement inside niche and niche entrance applies. Cross-section drawings demonstrating this clearance are not provided; niche service configuration not confirmed.

runComments.comment: Transformer Pad 3 is located within a Vault Easement boundary per electrical plan notation. If this constitutes a niche service (equipment within building-like footprint, accessible from outside), a minimum 35-foot vertical clearance is required inside the niche and niche entrance. Cross-section drawings demonstrating this clearance are not provided. The presence of a niche configuration and its clearance compliance cannot be verified.

details.text: If Pad 3 within Vault Easement is a niche service installation, 3-hour fire wall rating for walls and ceilings, ventilation system specifications, and Austin Energy Design business unit consultation documentation are required but not visible in submitted documentation.

runComments.comment: If Transformer Pad 3 within the Vault Easement represents a niche service installation, architectural specifications showing 3-hour fire wall rating for walls and ceilings, ventilation system specifications, and documentation of Austin Energy Design business unit consultation are required. These specifications and approvals are not visible in the submitted electrical, architectural, or specification documentation.

details.text: Transformer pad dimensions (length × width × depth) not specified on electrical plan. Service type (single-phase or three-phase) not identified. No reference to AE Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for specified service type provided in construction documents.

runComments.comment: Sheet 21 shows four transformer pads labeled as 'Electrical Transformer Pad' but provides NO dimensions specifying pad size (length × width × depth). The requirement mandates that transformer pad dimensions match Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase). No pad dimensions are provided on the plans, and no reference to Austin Energy Design detail sheets or service type specifications is documented. This is a critical omission.

Transformer pad dimensions are not specified or shown on the electrical plan. Service type (single-phase or three-phase) is not identified for any transformer. AE Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for the specified service type are not included in the submitted documentation. Pad dimensions must match AE Design standards for the intended service configuration, and details are required for construction compliance.

Transformer pad dimensions not shown on electrical plan. No reference to Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for specified service type (single-phase or three-phase). Pad sizing and specifications not verifiable.

comments.headline: Building and structural clearances undimensioned
comments.summary: Clearance distances from transformer pads to adjacent building structures are not dimensioned on plans. Cross-sectional documentation of vertical relationships between pads and overhead structures is absent. If reduced 3-foot clearances are used (vs. standard 5-foot minimum), Austin Energy Design written approval and supporting documentation are required but not provided.
comments.attn: Confirm clearance dimensions from building facades. If any reduced clearances are used, obtain AE Design written approval and verify four conditions: (1) location not in confined space, (2) minimum 10 feet to windows/doors/ducts, (3) minimum 15 feet vertical clearance, (4) minimum 3-hour fire rating.

details.text: Horizontal clearance dimensions from transformer pad edges to building structures not labeled on Sheets 21 or 9. Minimum 5-foot clearance per UCM § 1.10.4 cannot be verified. Visual estimates suggest 10–25 feet, but exact dimensions are required for compliance verification.

runComments.comment: Transformer pads are shown on Sheet 21 and Sheet 9, but no horizontal clearance dimensions are labeled from pad edges to building structures. Visual estimates suggest pads are positioned 10-25 feet from nearest building edges, which would meet the minimum 5-foot requirement, but exact dimensions are not provided on the plans for verification.
Transformer pads shown on Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) in proximity to buildings but clearance dimensions not provided. Minimum 5-foot clearance from buildings cannot be verified from submitted plans.

details.text: No cross-section or elevation drawing shows whether building structures, overhangs, balconies, or roof projections extend directly above any transformer pad. Requirement prohibiting coverings/structures above pads cannot be verified without vertical documentation.

runComments.comment: Electrical and site plans do not show building elevations, overhang details, or roof projections above transformer pad locations. Absence of cross-section or elevation drawings showing whether any structures, overhangs, or balconies project directly above the pads prevents verification of the requirement that no covering or structure is allowed directly above the pad.

details.text: No clearance dimensions labeled on any plan sheet. If any transformer pad uses reduced 3-foot clearance (vs. standard 5-foot minimum), AE Design written approval required along with documentation: (1) location not in confined space, (2) minimum 10 feet to windows/doors/ducts, (3) minimum 15 feet vertical clearance, (4) minimum 3-hour fire rating. No such approval or documentation visible.

runComments.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on the plans. Without documented clearance values, cannot determine whether any pads use reduced 3-foot clearances (which would require Austin Energy Design written approval and verification of four specific conditions: not in confined space, 10 ft+ to windows/doors/ducts, 15 ft+ vertical clearance, and 3-hour fire rating). No Austin Energy Design written approvals or architectural fire rating specifications are provided.

Transformer Pad 3 is located approximately 4-6 feet from Building 8 wall. If this represents a reduced clearance from the standard 5-foot minimum, written Austin Energy Design approval would be required, along with documentation that: (1) location is not in confined space, (2) minimum 10 feet to windows/doors/ducts, (3) minimum 15 feet vertical clearance to windows/doors/ducts, and (4) minimum 3-hour fire rating. No such approval or supporting documentation visible on submitted plans.

comments.headline: Transformer pad access door orientation not documented
comments.summary: No transformer pad access door orientation is indicated on the electrical plan. This is critical because clearance requirements vary significantly by which side the access door faces: hot-stick use areas require 10-foot clearance; vegetation and other features require different clearances based on door location (10 feet access side, 5 feet other sides).
comments.attn: Electrical plan must clearly indicate access door orientation for all five transformer pads using directional arrow or notation such as 'Access Door Faces [N/S/E/W]'.

details.text: Hot-stick use area (access door side) must maintain minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4. However, no access door orientation is indicated on any transformer pad, so clearance requirement cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: The hot-stick use area (access door side) must maintain minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure. However, no access door orientation is indicated on any transformer pad, and no clearance dimensions are labeled from pads to adjacent features.

Electrical plan does not indicate access door orientation for any transformer pad. The hot-stick use area (access door side) must maintain minimum 10 feet to open area or adjacent building/structure, but without documented access door position and whether this side faces open area or enclosed space, compliance cannot be verified.
Transformer pad access door orientation not indicated on plans. Hot-stick use area clearance (minimum 10 feet) cannot be verified without pad orientation and clearance dimensions.

details.text: Determination of whether pads are in confined spaces (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides) depends on access door orientation. If applicable, 15-foot confined-space clearance requirement applies. Cross-section drawings are not provided; compliance cannot be verified without access door orientation.

runComments.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing whether any transformer locations are in confined spaces (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides). Without access door orientation and vertical clearance documentation, the 15-foot confined space clearance requirement cannot be verified.

Electrical plan does not identify access door orientation or whether any transformer location faces confined space (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides). Cross-section drawings demonstrating 15-foot clearance (if applicable) are not provided. Compliance with confined space clearance requirement cannot be verified.

details.text: Landscape Plan shows shrub and vegetation locations but does not mark clearance dimensions from transformer pads or access doors. Required clearances are 10 feet from access door side and 5 feet from other sides per UCM § 1.10.10.4. Access door orientation must be documented on electrical plan; transformer pads not depicted on landscape plan. Compliance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows broad landscape zones (H.1 through H.7 hatch areas) but does not provide detailed shrub or low-lying vegetation planting locations. Transformer pads are not depicted on the landscape plan. Without access door orientation on the electrical plan and without detailed shrub locations on landscape plan, the 10-foot clearance (access door side) and 5-foot clearance (other sides) requirements cannot be verified.

Landscape Plan shows shrub and vegetation locations but does not identify individual planting locations with clearance dimensions from transformer pads or access doors. Access door orientation for transformer pads is not documented on electrical plan. Compliance with 10-foot access door clearance and 5-foot non-access door clearance cannot be verified.
Landscape plan shows vegetation areas but clearances from transformer access doors (10 feet vs. 5 feet based on door orientation) not dimensioned. Compliance not verifiable.

comments.headline: Underground utility clearances undimensioned
comments.summary: Multiple underground utility lines (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric) are shown in proximity to transformer pads, but no horizontal or vertical separation dimensions are labeled. The 5-foot minimum clearance from water, wastewater, and storm drain, and 12-inch clearance from electric lines cannot be verified. Storm drain at Pad 3 shows possible critical violation.
comments.crossDep: Stormwater/Drainage (Pad 3 storm drain conflict resolution); Water/Wastewater utilities (line routing coordination)
comments.attn: CRITICAL: Pad 3 storm drain conflict requires immediate verification via profile section or measurement. Vision analysis indicates clearance may be <5 feet or zero. All utility clearances must be dimensioned on electrical plan or utility profile sheets. Provide horizontal and vertical separations for each utility line near each pad.

details.text: Water lines shown on Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) and Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) near all transformer pad locations, but no horizontal clearance dimensions labeled between pad edges and water line locations. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance per UCM § 2.9.1.B.2 cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Water lines (W) are shown on Sheet 21 near all transformer pads, and on Sheet 19 (Utility Tap Plan). However, no specific horizontal clearance dimensions are labeled between pad edges and water line locations. Measurement tool would be appropriate for verification if visual dimensions are insufficient.

Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) shows water line routing through the site, but clearance dimensions between water lines and transformer pads are not marked. The minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from water lines cannot be verified without marked dimensions on the electrical or utility plan.
Water lines shown on utility plan in proximity to transformer pads but clearance dimensions not provided. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance not verifiable.

details.text: Wastewater lines shown on Utility Tap Plan and Electrical Plan near transformer pad locations (notably TP3 with WW line ~5–10 feet away west side), but no horizontal clearance dimensions labeled. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance per UCM § 2.9.1.B.2 cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Wastewater lines (WW) are shown on Sheet 21 near transformer pad locations, particularly TP3 which has a WW line running approximately 5-10 feet away on the west side. However, no specific horizontal clearance dimensions are labeled.

Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) shows wastewater line routing through the site, but clearance dimensions between wastewater lines and transformer pads are not marked. The minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from wastewater lines cannot be verified without marked dimensions.
Wastewater lines shown on utility plan in proximity to transformer pads but clearance dimensions not provided. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance not verifiable.

details.text: Storm drain line on Sheet 21 runs directly through corridor between Buildings 4 and 5 where Transformer Pad 3 is located. Vision analysis indicates storm drain passes extremely close to or directly underneath pad with clearance visually estimated <5 feet, possibly zero. No separation dimensions shown; no profile view provided. Run 1 flagged as definitive failure. This represents critical violation requiring immediate resolution.

runComments.comment: Sheet 21 shows a storm drain line (SD) running directly through the corridor between Buildings 4 and 5 where Transformer Pad 3 is located. Vision analysis indicates the storm drain line passes extremely close to, or potentially directly underneath, the transformer pad symbol (clearance visually estimated at < 5 feet). No separation dimensions are shown. No profile view is provided demonstrating clearance. This represents a clear violation of the minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement.

Storm Sewer Plan (Sheet 12) and Electrical Plan (Sheet 21) show storm drain and transformer locations, but clearance dimensions between storm drain lines and transformer pads are not marked. The minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance cannot be verified without marked dimensions.
Storm drain lines shown on both storm sewer and electrical plans in close proximity to transformer pads but clearance dimensions not provided. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance not verifiable.

details.text: Multiple underground utilities shown near transformer pads (electric, water, wastewater, storm drain lines), but no specific horizontal or vertical separation dimensions labeled on any plan or profile sheet. Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities per UCM § 1.10.5.A cannot be verified without profile views or dimensioned separation callouts.

runComments.comment: Multiple underground utilities are shown near transformer pads (electric lines, water lines, wastewater lines, storm drain lines), but no specific separation dimensions (horizontal or vertical) are labeled on any plan or profile sheet. The minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities cannot be verified without profile views or dimensioned separation callouts.

Utility plans show water, wastewater, and storm drain lines, but specific horizontal and vertical clearance dimensions between transformer pads and underground utilities are not marked. The 12-inch minimum horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities cannot be verified without marked dimensions or utility profile/detail sheets.
Multiple utilities shown in proximity to transformer pads but 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearances not dimensioned. Compliance not verifiable.

comments.headline: Landscape plan lacks species and clearance specifications
comments.summary: The Landscape Plan shows trees and shrub zones using category codes, but does not identify specific tree species or document utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F. Shrub and vegetation clearance dimensions from transformer pads are not marked. Root barrier specifications for trees within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads are absent.
comments.crossDep: Arborist/Forester (utility-compatible species verification; root barrier specifications)
comments.attn: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) must identify all tree species and confirm utility-compatible designation per ECM Appendix F. Shrub clearance dimensions must be added, referenced to transformer pad access door orientation (see Comment 3). Root barrier detail sheets must be prepared (4-foot minimum depth, 5-foot distance from equipment per UCM § 1.10.10.4).

details.text: Trees shown on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) along property perimeters with tree list on Sheet 32, but specific species identification and ECM Appendix F utility-compatibility verification not documented. Trees are present in proximity to all transformer pads. Transformer pads not depicted on landscape plan, so exact distances from trees to pads cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Trees are shown on the landscape plan (Sheet 31) along property perimeters, and a tree list is provided (Sheet 32), but specific tree species identification and utility-compatibility verification per ECM Appendix F are not documented. Additionally, transformer pads are not depicted on the landscape plan, so exact distances from trees to pads cannot be verified.

Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows tree locations using category codes (SY, PL, P, M) but does not provide species identification or cross-reference to ECM Appendix F utility-compatible tree list. Sheet 21 does not show specific distances between transformer pads and proposed trees. Compliance with utility-compatible species requirement and 10/15-foot clearance rules cannot be verified without species identification and marked clearance dimensions.

Trees are present in proximity to all transformer pads. Specific tree species and utility-compatible (UC) designation per ECM Appendix F not provided. 10-foot and 15-foot lateral clearance and utility-compatibility cannot be verified.

details.text: Trees shown on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) and tree protection/planting details on Sheet 37, but specific identification of trees within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads is not documented. Root barrier details (4-foot minimum depth, 5-foot distance from equipment per UCM § 1.10.10.4) are not shown on landscape or construction detail sheets. Compliance cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: Trees are shown on landscape plan (Sheet 31), and tree protection/planting details are provided (Sheet 37), but specific identification of trees within 20 lateral feet of transformer pads is not documented. Transformer pads are not depicted on the landscape plan. No root barrier details are shown near transformer locations.

Landscape Plan shows trees but does not identify species or provide root barrier details. Electrical Plan does not show specific distances from transformer pads to trees within 20-foot radius. No detail sheets showing root barrier specifications (4-foot minimum depth, 5-foot distance from equipment) are visible. Compliance with root barrier requirement cannot be verified.
Trees present near transformer pads but root barrier specifications not shown on landscape detail sheets. Root barrier requirements per UCM § 1.10.10.4 cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Site features lack documented clearances
comments.summary: Seven site features (fence, sidewalk, fire hydrant, dumpster, bike rack, light pole, fire lane) are shown on plans in proximity to transformer pads but lack documented clearance dimensions. Clearance requirements range from 3 to 15 feet depending on feature type and pad orientation.
comments.attn: Electrical and Site Plans must dimension clearances from transformer pad edges to each site feature. Access door orientation (see Comment 3) required for fence clearance verification (5 feet with operators/controls; 3 feet without).

details.text: Fences shown on site plan (pond perimeter fence, wood fence on east boundary, pond access gates) but exact locations relative to transformer pads and specific clearance distances not dimensioned. Removable ventilated fences require 5-foot clearance (sides with operators/controls) or 3-foot clearance (sides without) per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4; cannot verify without access door orientation and marked dimensions.

runComments.comment: Fences are shown on the site plan (pond perimeter fence, wood fence on east boundary, pond access gates), but exact locations relative to transformer pads, access door orientations, and specific clearance distances are not dimensioned. Cannot verify compliance with 5-foot (for sides with operators/controls) or 3-foot (for sides without operators/controls) clearances without access door orientation documentation.

Site plan does not show fences or gates adjacent to transformer pads with marked clearance dimensions. Access door orientation for each pad not indicated on electrical plan, preventing verification of required 5-foot (operators/controls) vs. 3-foot (no operators/controls) clearances to removable ventilated fences.

details.text: Sidewalks shown on Sheets 9 and 21; several transformer pads adjacent to sidewalk areas (particularly TP1 and TP2 on western side), but no specific clearance dimensions from back of sidewalk to pad edges are labeled per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.

runComments.comment: Sidewalks are shown on Sheets 9 and 21, and several transformer pads are adjacent to sidewalk areas (particularly TP1 and TP2 on the western side). However, no specific clearance dimensions from the back of sidewalk to pad edges are labeled.
Sidewalks are present on site plan but no clearance dimensions are shown between transformer pads and back of sidewalks. Compliance not verifiable.

Minimum 5-foot clearance per Reviewer Convention cannot be verified without marked dimensions, notably near southeast Building 7 location.

runComments.comment: Fire hydrants are shown on Sheet 10 (two 'Proposed Fire Hydrant' locations marked), but no clearance dimensions are labeled from these hydrants to the four transformer pads on Sheet 21.

Fire Protection Plan shows one existing fire hydrant off-site and two proposed fire hydrants on-site, but does not show specific clearance dimensions between transformer pads and fire hydrant locations. The 5-foot clearance requirement cannot be verified without marked dimensions between the two features.
Fire hydrant shown on plan in proximity to transformer pad but clearance dimension not provided. Minimum 5-foot clearance not verifiable.

details.text: No dumpster or trash enclosure locations shown on site plan adjacent to transformer pads, or clearance dimensions documented if present. Minimum 5-foot clearance per Reviewer Convention cannot be evaluated if dumpster locations are not identified on plans.

runComments.comment: No dumpster or trash enclosure locations are shown on the site plan adjacent to transformer pads. Without explicit depiction of dumpster locations relative to transformer pads, the 5-foot minimum clearance requirement cannot be verified.

Site and electrical plans do not show dumpsters or waste collection areas adjacent to transformer pads. The 5-foot clearance requirement cannot be evaluated if dumpsters are not proposed near transformer locations.

details.text: Bike parking shown elsewhere on site (41 spaces per Sheet 9 Parking Data table), but specific proximity to transformer pads not documented with clearance dimensions. Minimum 5-foot clearance per Reviewer Convention cannot be verified without documented bike rack locations near pads.

runComments.comment: Site and electrical plans do not show bike racks adjacent to transformer pads. The 5-foot clearance requirement cannot be evaluated if bike racks are not proposed near transformer locations. Bike parking is shown elsewhere on site (per Sheet 9 Parking Data table: 41 spaces provided), but specific proximity to transformer pads is not documented.

details.text: Site plan does not show light pole locations adjacent to transformer pads with marked clearance dimensions per Reviewer Convention. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified without documented light pole locations and dimensions.

runComments.comment: Site plan does not show light pole locations adjacent to transformer pads with marked clearance dimensions. The 5-foot clearance requirement cannot be verified without documented light pole locations and dimensions.

details.text: Fire lanes shown on Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10, 26-foot width, looping through site). Transformer Pad 1 (northwest, main entrance area) is adjacent to main driveway serving as fire lane. Visual analysis estimates pad 2–5 feet from fire lane edge, potentially violating 15-foot minimum clearance per Reviewer Convention. No dimension labeled on plans; clearance cannot be verified.

Visual analysis suggests the pad is approximately 2-5 feet from the fire lane edge, which would violate the 15-foot minimum clearance if the standard applies. However, no explicit 15-foot dimension is labeled on the plans.

Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows fire lanes with 26-foot width but does not mark specific distance from transformer pads to fire lane centerlines or edges. The 15-foot clearance from fire lanes cannot be verified without marked clearance dimensions.

comments.attn: Electrical plan must identify and locate overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors with clearance dimensions from transformer pads. If overhead lines present on adjacent properties, consult AE Design regarding clearance verification.

Electrical Plan does not identify overhead conductors; utility legends do not include overhead electric symbols. Minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance per UCM § 1.10.3 not verifiable.

Overhead electric line shown on site plan along southern boundary but clearance from transformer pads not dimensioned. 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance not verifiable.

comments.headline: Vertical clearance cross-sectional documentation missing
comments.summary: No cross-section or profile drawings show vertical clearances between transformer pads and underground utilities, or vertical clearance in access paths. Requirements prohibit transformers/AE facilities from being positioned directly over/under other utility lines and prohibit customer buildings/structures from being placed over AE underground facilities (per UCM § 1.10.3 and § 1.10.5.B). Vertical compliance cannot be verified without sectional documentation.
comments.crossDep: Stormwater (vertical clearance to storm drain); Structural/Grading (pad elevation, surrounding grades, overhead structures)
comments.attn: Utility profile and cross-section sheets required showing vertical relationships between transformer pads and all nearby underground utilities (water, sewer, storm drain, electric). Cross-sections must demonstrate vertical clearance in access paths (minimum 15 feet if applicable). Grading Plan (Sheet 11) shows topographic contours indicating varying grades; cross-sections will clarify vertical positioning and potential conflicts.

details.text: No cross-section or profile drawing shows vertical relationships between transformer pads and utility lines running underneath or above them. Requirement prohibits transformers/AE facilities from being positioned over/under other utility lines per UCM § 1.10.5.B. Multiple underground utilities shown near pads (electric, water, wastewater, storm drain) but vertical separation is undocumented.

runComments.comment: The plans show utilities routed near transformer pads and buildings located in the immediate vicinity of transformer locations. However, no cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical relationships between transformer pads and utility lines running underneath or above them. The requirement prohibits transformers or AE facilities from being located over/under other utility lines, or customer buildings/structures from being placed over AE underground facilities. Without profile or cross-section views, this cannot be verified.

Electrical and utility plans do not provide vertical profile drawings or sections showing whether transformer pads are positioned directly over/under other utility lines, or whether buildings/structures/foundations will be constructed over AE underground electric facilities. Utility profile sheets or cross-sections needed to verify this requirement are not included in available documentation.
Utility plans show plan view relationships but section drawings not provided to verify vertical clearance. Over/under conflicts cannot be verified.

runComments.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided on the plan set showing vertical clearances in access paths with overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas. Sheet 11 (Grading Plan) shows topographic contours indicating varying grades across the site, which implies potential overhead structures or grade changes that could affect vertical clearances to transformer access areas. Without cross-sections demonstrating vertical clearance compliance, this requirement is not met.

Cross-section or profile drawings showing vertical clearances at transformer pad locations in relation to overhead structures, parking garages, enclosed areas, or niches are not provided in the submitted plan set. Without these cross-sectional views, vertical clearance compliance in access paths cannot be verified.
No cross-section drawings provided showing vertical clearances from transformer pad access areas. Cross-sections required by UCM § 1.10.3 for demonstrating clearance compliance are missing.

comments.headline: Easement conflicts and private property compliance unverified
comments.summary: Four recorded easements affecting the site are not clearly documented on the electrical plan: Greenbelt Access & Use (0.31 acres, NE interior), City of Austin Drainage (0.130 acres, NE corner), 25' Drainage, and Public Utility/Electric Easements. Transformer Pad 3 is explicitly within a Vault Easement; placement in prohibited easements requires Austin Energy Design written approval (not provided). Transformer easement boundaries and electrical routing private-property confirmation also missing.
comments.crossDep: Legal/Title (easement verification, boundary clarification); Austin Energy Design (written approvals for equipment in easements)
comments.attn: CRITICAL: Verify Pad 3 position relative to Vault Easement and obtain AE Design written approval if equipment placement within easement is required. Title commitment must list all recorded easements (including undepicted Greenbelt and Drainage Easements). Electrical plan must annotate which transformer pads are within/outside easements with dimensions to easement boundaries. Provide AE Design approvals where applicable. Electrical routing to meters must be confirmed 100% on private property with dimension references.

details.text: Transformer Pad 3 is located within a Vault Easement per electrical plan notation. comments.headline: Transformer pad vehicle impact protection missing
comments.summary: Transformer Pad 1 (northwest, main entrance area) is positioned 2–5 feet from main entrance driveway curb edge, within the 4-foot vehicle circulation threshold requiring protective bollards. Bollards (4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts per AE Design pad details) are shown at other pad locations but are absent at Pad 1 despite its critical main-entrance location.
comments.attn: Confirm actual distance from Pad 1 curb edge to driveway. If distance <4 feet, add 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollards per AE Design pad detail sheets. If ≥4 feet, dimension on plan for verification. Compare to bollard treatment at other pads shown on plan for consistency.

details.text: Transformer Pad 1 (NW area, main site entrance) positioned 2–5 feet from main entrance driveway curb edge (primary vehicle circulation route), within 4-foot threshold requiring bollard protection per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4. Bollards (4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts per AE Design pad details) ARE shown at other pad locations (east side, Buildings 4–5 and 7) for similar vehicle proximity hazards, but no bollards shown or dimensioned around Pad 1. runComments.comment: Transformer Pad 1 is located in the northwest area of the site, immediately adjacent to the main entrance driveway (which provides access to parking and vehicle circulation). Visual analysis using the 1"=20' scale indicates the pad is positioned approximately 2-5 feet from the driveway curb edge. The requirement mandates that equipment pads installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes must have 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details. Bollards ARE shown on the site plan at other locations (east side, near Buildings 4-5 and 7), but NO bollards are shown around Transformer Pad 1 despite its proximity to the main vehicle entrance/circulation driveway within the 4-foot threshold.

Transformer Pad 1 is located in the NW area of the site near the main driveway entrance and adjacent surface parking spaces. Visual measurement estimates the pad to be approximately 20 feet from the nearest parking spaces to the east (exceeds 4-foot threshold). However, the pad is located immediately adjacent to the inner edge of the curved driveway/vehicle circulation route, with the curb less than 5 feet away. Bollards are not shown on either the electrical plan or site plan protecting this pad from vehicle impact. Given the proximity to active vehicle circulation (less than 5 feet), bollards are required. The absence of 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized bollards per AE Design pad details constitutes a deficiency.
